title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Low-Resource Languages: A Comparative Study of LLMs for Bengali Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of parameter-efficient fine-tuned LLMs on binary hate speech classification using the BD-SHS dataset, which includes specific target annotations for hate speech directed at male and female demographics.

Evaluating the performance of parameter-efficient fine-tuned LLMs on binary hate speech classification using the BD-SHS dataset, which includes a distinct categorization for texts containing 'Religious Hate'.
